summary: Innovative Industrial Properties, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) to update its existing at-the-market (ATM) equity distribution program. The filing discloses that on August 31, 2026, the company added Huntington Securities as a sales agent, forward seller, and forward purchaser, and terminated its equity distribution agreement with Jefferies LLC. As of the filing date, the company had sold 859,497 shares of common stock and 5,066,082 shares of 9.00% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock, leaving approximately $336.9 million available under the program. The common stock traded at $56.31 per share on August 28, 2026. This is a routine ATM program update, not a special situation.
